ruleDefinitions.name: Internet Explorer Autorun Keys Modification
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects modification of autostart extensibility point (ASEP) in registry. Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Wow6432Node\\\\Microsoft\\\\Internet\\ Explorer.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Internet\\ Explorer.*")) AND (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Toolbar.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Extensions.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Explorer\\ Bars.*")) AND  NOT (Details = "\(Empty\)" OR (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Extensions\\\\\\{2670000A\\-7350\\-4f3c\\-8081\\-5663EE0C6C49\\}.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Extensions\\\\\\{31D09BA0\\-12F5\\-4CCE\\-BE8A\\-2923E76605DA\\}.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Extensions\\\\\\{789FE86F\\-6FC4\\-46A1\\-9849\\-EDE0DB0C95CA\\}.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Extensions\\\\\\{A95fe080\\-8f5d\\-11d2\\-a20b\\-00aa003c157a\\}.*")) OR (registry_path = RGX("\\\\Toolbar\\\\ShellBrowser\\\\ITBar7Layout$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\Toolbar\\\\ShowDiscussionButton$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\Toolbar\\\\Locked$")))
